implementation_summary: F-002/DEC-004: with no RUNNER_ACCESS_TOKEN, carriesAccessKey is true only for loopback socket addresses (127.0.0.1, ::1, ::ffff:127.0.0.1) via the new pure isLoopbackAddress in routes/route.ts (re-exported from routes/index.ts), so authorizeRoute refuses non-loopback callers with 401 ERR_ACCESS_KEY; keyed behaviour unchanged; inline endpoints untouched because grantAccess still returns early without a key. Helper wiring: RunnerServerOptions.helperAccess (HelperAccess); helperGrants defaults to helperAccess.helperGrants (explicit option wins); refused requests without the key get helperAccess.refusal(req, route.access, params) as { error, code } (owner rows checked before grantAccess unless ?access= is present; all rows after authorizeRoute refuses), otherwise the existing refusal; id-less 'view' rows let through a signed-in Helper holding any grant where allows(grant,'view'), read from the store on each request; resolver errors grant nothing. Duplicate HelperPermission in route.ts removed: imported from @qa/types and re-exported.

risks: Behaviour change (DEC-004): with no RUNNER_ACCESS_TOKEN, table rows with owner/view/edit/export access (today the Plan routes) refuse any non-loopback peer with 401. A deployment without a token behind a proxy (Docker port mapping, Cloud Run) would lose the Plan routes. cli.ts already refuses a non-loopback bind without a token, so supported setups are unaffected. Inline endpoints are not gated by this change.

beta.test.ts 'a runner that is not a beta is never limited' fails with ENOTEMPTY in its own fs.rm cleanup when run together with other files. It passes alone. It fails the same way without route-access-server.test.ts in the run (access-token + beta), so it is not caused by the new tests. Not in my ownership; CHK-BE-102-SERVER may fail on it.
Id-less view rows let any Helper with a grant through. This relies on the handlers (GET /api/audits, GET /api/shortlist) filtering by grantedAuditIds; check that when BE-190 registers them.
A signed-in Helper on an owner row without the key now gets 403 ERR_FORBIDDEN instead of the 401 key refusal (intended, REVIEW-003 #3).
handoff: Wire production with `new RunnerServer({ ..., helperAccess: createHelperAccess({ ...helperSettingsFromEnv(), store }) })` (cli/BE-190); helperGrants then defaults to helperAccess.helperGrants. Dispatch now answers signed-in Helpers in the audit error model (404 ERR_AUDIT_NOT_FOUND / 403 ERR_FORBIDDEN) and lets them reach id-less 'view' rows when they hold any view-or-higher grant, so those handlers must filter per Helper. isLoopbackAddress is exported from routes/index.ts. HelperPermission now comes from @qa/types (route.ts re-exports it). Audit route files are not registered (BE-190).
